subject: Full proposed grabber retrofit, b view

neck_geometry: The stock silver neck is a rectangular prism with a square cross-section, flat faces, and sharp longitudinal edges; every shaft clamp must fit the square profile, not a cylinder.
color_key: Only the stock center brace and stock handle are blue. All added 3D-printed retrofit parts are orange. Stock metal remains silver; original claw feet and squeeze trigger remain black.

axes.x: out of the page toward the viewer, shown as a circled dot

requirements: Show the complete assembly from an intended viewpoint rotated 90 degrees around the upright y-axis; do not rotate the paper or tilt the neck. Retain the earlier centered phone layout rather than copying the latest 1a phone translation.
One complete reacher and its attachments in one view; no inset or additional view.
The claw arms and plastic feet overlap in projection; only the back of one plastic claw foot is visible.
Show the one stock blue center brace clearly at its 0b midshaft location, below the raised phone; do not relocate or duplicate the brace.
Rotate the handle counterclockwise with the assembly so the upper blue handle head is visible and the black squeeze trigger is hidden behind it.
The phone remains below the claw fork with its plane perpendicular to the neck and its cameras facing the claws. This view shows its long side, not the charging-port edge.
Translate the iPhone, orange split neck mount, orange corner harness, and orange volume-button lever together in positive y so the stock blue center brace is visible below the phone.
Keep the phone centered across the neck as in the earlier b-view concept; do not apply the positive-x and negative-z phone translation requested for 1a.
Keep the external bicycle brake cable on the shaft and route it into the hidden trigger coupling consistently with 3b.
Show a small x/y/z axis glyph on opaque white paper: positive y up, positive z left, and positive x out of the page as a circled dot, in a technical engineering drawing style.
